seal.statement: Remove the ACTIVE row that the transaction coordinator writes on sql_transaction_participants at the first write to each table, at its single producer (enlistParticipantsOwned and the overlap that waits for it in executeWriteStatement). The manifest on sql_transactions, appended by exact compare-and-set before any participant request, remains the admitted participant set; participant rows begin with the PREPARE evidence. The participant's in-memory transition to ACTIVE when its BEGIN succeeds stays and is witnessed: a participant already begun is never begun again, also after a read promoted to a write, after an AUTHORITATIVE enlistment (locking read, global index, bindTransactionToPartition) and after the participant lost its session, so earlier staged writes are never silently dropped by a second BEGIN. Recovery, release, decision and settlement behaviour are unchanged. What the removal leaves without a caller is deleted in the same change (evidence/design-note.md, section C6). Expected effect: a write transaction waits for up to P fewer sequential consensus rounds (new_order 19 -> 14, payment 17 -> 13) and submits P fewer proposals and CDC obligations (new_order 36 -> 31 proposals, payment 30 -> 26).
